evals.prompt: Start a 100-case Rust coverage campaign. The current Codex turn is Sol Max, but I want Sol High for ideas and Luna Max for implementation and validation.
evals.expected_output: Stops before editing and asks for the main turn to run on gpt-5.6-luna with max reasoning. It keeps Luna as the sole writer and uses a read-only gpt-5.6-sol high subagent for bounded strategy; it does not pretend the requested routing is active on Sol Max.

evals.prompt: Raise coverage in /work/project-a. Coverage MCP project_context reports /work/coverage-mcp with no matching suite, but a Make coverage target exists locally.
evals.expected_output: Returns BLOCKED_MCP_CONTEXT before mutation because the connector is bound to a foreign repository. It does not substitute raw Make output for the managed baseline and asks to reconnect Coverage MCP to /work/project-a.

evals.prompt: Coverage MCP identifies three reachable parser files. Generate a fast batch of 100 public inputs without implementing yet.
evals.expected_output: Builds a bounded strategy request from exact snapshot, target, source-context, generator, neighboring-test, and registered validation-lane evidence; spawns a read-only gpt-5.6-sol high strategist with no inherited chat; and requires 10 coherent families of 10 mapped to exact regions and public reachability paths without invented command names.

evals.prompt: Several uncovered branches require an internal enum value that no public constructor, decoder, binding, fixture route, or approved coverage hook can produce.
evals.expected_output: Rejects guessed or private reachability. It asks Sol for evidence, classifies the paths as unsupported or unreachable when that evidence holds, preserves them in the denominator, and moves to another ranked public target without inventing fake inputs.

evals.prompt: A generated 100-case parity batch has 20 failures with identical bytes and one repeated metadata mismatch. The other 80 pass.
evals.expected_output: Runs and classifies the complete family-sized batch before editing product code, consolidates the common defect into one bounded Luna fix, retains the revealing inputs as regression cases, reruns every affected family, and measures coverage only after parity is green.

evals.prompt: All 100 new cases pass, but the valid final snapshot has no new line, branch, function, or region coverage and the cases document no separate regression.
evals.expected_output: Uses the explicit snapshot comparison, removes the zero-gain campaign batch, reports proposed/generated/removed counts and zero measured delta, and does not retain corpus padding or change the denominator.

evals.prompt: The full batch adds coverage, but only a batch-level snapshot exists. Remove every individual case that did not add a line.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to infer per-case uniqueness from batch evidence. It uses already approved family slices when proportionate, retains cases when safe attribution is unavailable, and reports unmeasured attribution instead of guessing.

evals.prompt: Luna implemented a proposed public 16-bit input, but the adapter rejects it before the intended function and the target stays red after one bounded attempt.
evals.expected_output: Creates a NEEDS_SOL packet with run and snapshot IDs, bounded failure literals, changed files, remaining ranges, observed behavior, and ruled-out hypotheses. It sends that packet to the same read-only Sol High strategist and allows no more than two revised Luna attempts for the target.

evals.prompt: The tests pass, but the coverage artifact is stale and automatic ingestion reports skipped_stale with no current snapshot ID.
evals.expected_output: Keeps test success distinct from coverage evidence, makes no improvement claim, reports the skipped_stale ingestion outcome, and reruns or repairs only the approved artifact workflow.

evals.prompt: Speed this up by spawning five Luna writers in the same dirty checkout while Sol reviews their edits.
evals.expected_output: Rejects parallel writers, preserves existing user changes, keeps the main Luna Max agent as the only writer, uses Sol High read-only, and parallelizes only isolated read-heavy analysis or separate user-authorized worktrees.

evals.prompt: The desired family-only coverage command is not registered. Create and run it now with whatever artifact path seems likely.
evals.expected_output: Does not invent or execute the command. It presents the exact command, cwd, shell, artifact paths, coverage format, and stable suite for human approval before registering it with human_approved=true.

evals.prompt: Send the strategist the complete 40,000-line test log and the full accumulated goal conversation so it can diagnose a failed family.
evals.expected_output: Keeps noisy execution context with Luna, searches logs for bounded exact literals, sends only the NEEDS_SOL contract and relevant source ranges to Sol with no inherited history, and preserves the main thread from context pollution.
